title: (RHBA-2016:1608) Red Hat OpenShift Enterprise 3.2.1.13 bug fix and enhancement update
portal_summary: Red Hat OpenShift Enterprise release 3.2.1.13 is now available with updates to packages and images that fix several bugs and add an enhancement.
portal_synopsis: Red Hat OpenShift Enterprise 3.2.1.13 bug fix and enhancement update
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.2|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata relevant to your system have been applied.

See the OpenShift Enterprise 3.2 documentation, which will be updated shortly for release 3.2.1.13, for important instructions on how to upgrade your cluster and fully apply this asynchronous errata update:

https://docs.openshift.com/enterprise/3.2/release_notes/ose_3_2_release_notes.html

This update is available via the Red Hat Network. Details on how to use the Red Hat Network to apply this update are available at https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258.

The Red Hat Enterprise Linux container images provided by this update can be downloaded from the Red Hat Container Registry at registry.access.redhat.com using the "docker pull" command. Dockerfiles and scripts should be amended either to refer to these new images specifically, or to the latest images generally.
portal_description:
OpenShift Enterprise by Red Hat is the company's cloud computing Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) solution designed for on-premise or private cloud deployments.

This update fixes the following bugs:

* In rare situations, a bug in Golang's net.http.Transport:CancelRequest library may have crashed the master process. This bug fix ensures this error is trapped, preventing the master process from crashing. (BZ#1360381)

* Previously, the logging deployer did not configure the local time zone for fluentd. This bug fix updates the deployer to ensure new logging deployments properly configure fluentd for the local time zone. See https://access.redhat.com/solutions/2377771 for details how to re-configure existing deployments. (BZ#1347368)

* Previously, if logs were generated with a `message` field, that field was overwritten by fluentd due to a field mapping error. This bug fix corrects the error ensuring that the `message` field is preserved if it exists. (BZ#1364819)

* A recent change to logging components altered the location of the default indexe,s resulting in the Log Archive link in the web console showing no results. This bug fix updates the web console to link to the new location. (BZ#1358674)

* Previously, a bug in initial quota calculations may have prevented resources from being created in newly created projects. This bug fix modifies quota calculation for newly created projects to ensure proper accounting prior to creating resources. (BZ#1351705)

* Containerized installations of OpenShift Enterprise (OSE) would previously fail to detach Cinder volumes due to the method used to find the volume. This bug fix updates OSE to correctly detach Cinder volumes when running in a containerized environment. (BZ#1339295)

In addition, this update adds the following enhancement:

* The integrated Docker registry now supports the Google Cloud Storage (GCS) storage driver. See https://docs.openshift.com/enterprise/3.2/install_config/install/docker_registry.html#docker-registry-configuration-reference-storage for configuration details. (BZ#1332301)

This update includes the following images:

openshift3/openvswitch:v3.2.1.13
openshift3/ose-pod:v3.2.1.13
openshift3/ose:v3.2.1.13
openshift3/ose-docker-registry:v3.2.1.13
openshift3/ose-keepalived-ipfailover:v3.2.1.13
openshift3/ose-recycler:v3.2.1.13
openshift3/ose-f5-router:v3.2.1.13
openshift3/ose-deployer:v3.2.1.13
openshift3/node:v3.2.1.13
openshift3/ose-sti-builder:v3.2.1.13
openshift3/ose-docker-builder:v3.2.1.13
openshift3/ose-haproxy-router:v3.2.1.13
openshift3/logging-fluentd:3.2.1
openshift3/logging-deployment:3.2.1

All OpenShift Enterprise 3 users are advised to upgrade to these updated packages and images.
